interface.shortDescription: US bank health and failures — FDIC BankFind Suite: FDIC-insured institution financials (Call Report metrics), bank failures since 1934, Summary of Deposits, and branch/structure data.
interface.longDescription: US bank health and failures from the FDIC BankFind Suite. Find FDIC-insured banks and savings institutions by name, location, or charter status; read their quarterly Call Report financials, including assets, deposits, net income, and capital ratios; search the failure and assistance record back to 1934, with estimated cost to the Deposit Insurance Fund; and pull Summary of Deposits branch-level deposits and market share. Keyless public data. Credit unions are not covered.
